faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Trichy Project Associate-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Project Associate-II post at NIT Trichy is 29 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to ensure their application is considered.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate-II post in the National Institute of Technology Trichy recruitment drive. This offers a specific opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the National Institute of Technology Trichy Project Associate-II recruitment is online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-II position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month. This is a contractual position at NIT Trichy.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E/B.Tech in CSE/IT/ECE/EEE or equivalent, preferably with M.E/M.Tech in CSE/IT or equivalent, and 2 years of industry/academic experience. A minimum of 60% or 6.5 CGPA in UG and PG is required.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India norms for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the Project Associate-II recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: The selection process for Project Associate-II includes a Written Test (if required) followed by an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Associate-II position is Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, specifically at the National Institute of Technology Trichy.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the NIT Trichy Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of National Institute of Technology Trichy. Ensure you fill out the application form carefully, upload all required documents, and submit it before the last date, 29 August 2026.
